v5.8.6 - Changelog
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Yukino Bijin 2026-08-04`. - Update Automation Library version to 2.5.9. - Retry the trainee name read instead of caching a null placeholder. - Improve mandatory race handling. - Rank Grand Live Lessons by priority order instead of summed weights.
Fixes --- - Fix incorrect text color used for the `Reset` popup in the `Scenario Overrides Settings` page. - Fix log names not being saved correctly from the `Remote Log Viewer`. - Fix broken copy button in the `Remote Log Viewer`. - Fix empty Analytics charts in the `Remote Log Viewer`.
